label: Quotient lockup (the 2026 logo, built)
description: An end card: the 2026 Quotient logo built the way the product's loader builds it -- a + spins into x, on into -, grows two dots into a division sign, turns on its side and swells into the mark (a half-circle and a dot) over `build` seconds from `at` -- then the wordmark "Quotient" (PP Museum, outlined, so no font is needed) cuts in one letter every letter_step seconds beside it, and an optional mono tag (e.g. the URL, with a coloured bar on its left) lands under the lockup. All of it is a pure function of the time. The lockup is centred on (x, y) at `width` of the box. Example: {"background":"#FFEFDE","tag":{"text":"getquotient.ai"}}.

build.label: Seconds from the + to the finished mark

letters_at.label: When the first letter lands (default 0.25 s after the mark)

width.label: Lockup width, fraction of the box (mark alone: 0.14)

x.label: Centre x, fraction of the box

y.label: Centre y, fraction of the box

tag.label: A mono label under the lockup: {text, at, bar, color, background, font, size, gap}; a string is the text
